versions.content: Definition of a collection of test results It is possible to assign a collection of test results to the mode 0x06. For this purpose, DiagnosticRequestOnBoardMonitoringTestResults shall refer to multiple DiagnosticTestResult s in the role diagnosticTestResult that in turn refers to the identical DiagnosticMeasurementIdentifier in the role monitoredIdentifier (taken as the identification of related test results in down- stream processing of a diagnostic extract).
